text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Oguri Cap had a mock race in class that afternoon,
we decided to have lunch together, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bag placed beside her was packed
with an unbelievable amount of onigiri and pastries.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I bought them at the school store.
This should be plenty to refuel my energy.
choice_data_list: How many meals' worth is that...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's one meal.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It will fill me up to about eighty percent.
If I eat too much, I won't be able to move, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I go to the cafeteria, I end up eating without restraint,
so sometimes I just buy from the school store like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spreading out her purchased food, Oguri Cap politely clasped
her hands together, said "Itadakimasu," and began eating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the wide blue sky, the food vanished into Oguri Cap
as though being swallowed by a black hole...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gochisousama deshita.
choice_data_list: Did you even chew your food...?
Did you remember to chew properly...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course I did.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Saying 'Itadakimasu' and 'Gochisousama,' and chewing thoroughly to savor each bite—
Tome-san taught me that's how you show gratitude to those who made the food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Most of the important things in life, I learned from the people back home.
To repay their kindness, I must keep growing here at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of Tome-san, the onigiri she often brought me
as refreshments were delicious. They were my absolute favorite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They were round and as big as shot puts,
wrapped in moist nori seaweed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They were packed full of fillings, too—grilled cod roe,
pickled mustard greens, and lots of simmered kelp tsukudani.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No matter where you took a bite, you'd reach the filling right away.
It always made me feel so happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumbleeee~...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Just remembering them made my stomach growl again...
I suppose eighty percent full wasn't quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even if I wanted to buy more,
I wonder if I'd make it back from the school store in time...
choice_data_list: I've got some onigiri if you want one?
I have an onigiri on me, would you like it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! May I really have it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Heh, then I gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her eyes sparkling, Oguri Cap took the onigiri
and began wolfing it down with incredible gusto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the blink of an eye, she polished off
all three rice balls I'd prepared for myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal.
By the way, Trainer, did you make these by hand?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They taste just like Tome-san's... gentle,
and heartwarming. That's the kind of rice ball it was.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Do you use a special technique when you shape them?
choice_data_list: I just threw them together without much thought.
I just threw them together without much thought.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...If it's not the technique, is there some other secret?
If you don't mind, could you show me how you make them sometime?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ever since moving here, I've really missed that taste.
I'd like to learn how to make them myself... Would you teach me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you! I truly appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Having you by my side really does bring me
the same sense of peace as being back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm genuinely glad that I asked you to be my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Having that gentle, familiar flavor after so long has satisfied both my stomach and soul.
Trainer, expect great things from my mock race this afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Oguri Cap went on to claim
an overwhelming victory in her mock race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was thrilled that my rice balls gave her
the fuel she needed to succeed, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*gurgle...*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't help wishing she had saved
at least one of them for me.
